cases.failure_mode: selects historical active rate instead of current state
cases.rationale: Current state must override older seizure-burden history.

cases.failure_mode: drops the current active-rate state because future review is mentioned
cases.rationale: Future review language is not the current seizure state.

cases.failure_mode: extracts planned clobazam as a current regimen
cases.rationale: Medication plans must stay separate from active regimens.

cases.failure_mode: treats pending MRI as performed with an unknown result
cases.rationale: Pending tests are not completed investigations with results.

cases.failure_mode: emits a generic or unsupported hierarchy diagnosis
cases.rationale: Hierarchy pressure cases must preserve the most specific assertion.

cases.failure_mode: preserves concept identity but flips negation to affirmed
cases.rationale: Concept-only recovery can hide assertion errors; companion scoring exposes them.

cases.failure_mode: uses paraphrased non-verbatim evidence for a correct fact
cases.rationale: Evidence paraphrase preserves the fact but fails exact-evidence validity.

cases.failure_mode: deletes evidence while keeping the clinical fact
cases.rationale: Evidence deletion should reduce evidence validity even when scoring stays correct.
